query: RTX 5090 user: ComfyUI pauses/hangs when running native Wan2.1 720p_fp16 workflows (FramePack example attached); 480p_bf16 and 720p_fp8 models run fine.

desired.outcome: Confirmed: the user solved it by increasing system memory — the fp16 model run was RAM-bound, not a GPU bug.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Distinguish a RAM-bound stall (fp16 weights overflow system memory) from a GPU bug, using the fp16-fails/fp8-bf16-works differential as the diagnostic clue.
